title: Know Your Standards
summary: Official BIS entry point for searching Indian Standards by number or keywords.
use: Use this official search before treating a product-to-standard match as final. BIS Sahayak uses it to route a plain-language product description toward the relevant Indian Standard.

title: Products under Compulsory Certification
summary: Official BIS listing hub for product categories covered under compulsory certification, registration or certificate of conformity pathways.
use: Use this page to confirm whether a product category is currently covered and to reach the relevant Scheme-I, Scheme-II, Scheme-IV or Scheme-X listing. It is not evidence that an unverified product is covered.

title: Scheme-II: Compulsory Registration Scheme
summary: Official category listing for Electronics and IT goods under the Compulsory Registration Scheme. The listing includes Laptop/Notebook/Tablets against IS/IEC 62368-1:2023.
use: Use the current official listing to verify whether the stated electronics product matches a notified category and standard. Confirm exclusions, amendments and applicability directly from BIS before acting.
lastUpdated: Current listing includes 10 Mar 2026 amendment references

title: Product Certification FAQ
summary: Official FAQ covering product certification, standards discovery, manufacturing readiness and the online application route.
use: Use this source to clarify the official pathway. It states that a manufacturer needs appropriate manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capability for the relevant Indian Standard.

title: Product Certification Process
summary: Official BIS process hub for Scheme-I and Scheme-IV documentation, grant, renewal, surveillance and related certification guidance.
use: Use the scheme-specific documents linked here to replace a prototype checklist with the official application sequence for the relevant product and scheme.

title: Product Specific Information
summary: Official gateway to product manuals, Scheme of Inspection and Testing documents, grouping guidelines and product-specific guidance.
use: Use it to obtain the product-specific evidence behind a final document and testing checklist. BIS Sahayak deliberately labels its own checklist as a readiness prompt until this material is checked.

title: BIS Recognized Labs
summary: Official BIS LIMS directory for recognized laboratories, including location, validity information and a laboratory scope view.
use: Use the live directory to find a possible laboratory and inspect its scope. A listing alone does not establish that a laboratory can perform a particular test for your product.

title: Guidance Document on Quality Control Orders
summary: BIS guidance explaining Quality Control Orders, compulsory use of a Standard Mark or Certificate of Conformity, and the importance of each Order’s commencement date.
use: Use it to understand why a QCO check matters. It does not decide whether a product falls within a QCO: that requires comparison with the current Order, listed product scope and any amendment or exemption.

title: BIS Care App
summary: Official BIS mobile-app page covering Verify Licence Details, Verify HUID, Know Your Standards and access to certification listings and laboratory information.
use: Use the official app for consumer-facing verification flows, including a Hallmarked Jewellery item’s HUID. BIS Sahayak only directs the user to that official verification step.

title: Hallmarking Overview
summary: Official BIS overview of hallmarking and a consumer route to get jewellery or a sample tested by a BIS recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre.
use: Use this source to distinguish an official verification or assay route from an AI opinion about a jewellery item’s authenticity or purity.

title: Scheme-X Certification FAQ
summary: Official BIS FAQ describing Scheme-X pathways, current compulsory-certification listings and applicant readiness concepts for the relevant Scheme-X product category.
use: Use only after confirming a product falls under the Scheme-X scope. The prototype links this record when the user asks about industrial products or Scheme-X; it makes no scheme classification on its own.

title: Guidelines for Certification of Refrigerating Appliances
summary: BIS product-specific certification guidance for listed refrigerating appliances, including the relevant standards and a reminder that the latest versions and notified amendments apply.
use: This is a demo product-specific record for refrigeration questions. Check the current compulsory listing and the latest applicable standard before acting, because this prototype corpus is intentionally small.

title: Scheme-X FAQ, Version 1 (April 2024)
summary: Versioned BIS FAQ noting the technical file and product compliance report context for Scheme-X applicants.
use: Use this as a versioned supporting source only when the official Scheme-X scope is confirmed. Read the current scheme guidance for final documents and test-report requirements.
